lock_scope.statement: This register lists 17 of the 287 locked packages individually (the ones the model code imports directly plus python/pytorch-cuda); the other 270 are transitive and are covered only by the lockfile hash (item lock-vision) and by the full-lock licence note below.

full_lock_license_note.statement: The release is RECREATED from the lockfile on the target machine; no package of the environment is shipped or redistributed by this release. The 287-package vision environment contains components under copyleft or proprietary terms (counted from the license fields of pixi.lock, which 258 of 287 entries carry; 29 entries carry none): GPL-2.0/3.0 (e.g. pyqt, readline, fftw, gettext-tools), LGPL, one AGPL-3.0-only (libdb), GPL-3.0 WITH GCC-exception (libgcc/libstdc++ runtime), NVIDIA End User License Agreement components (cuda-version, libcurand, cuda-opencl) and Intel proprietary (mkl). These are installed by pixi from the public channels at setup time and are not redistributed; if a future delivery ships the environment itself (a conda-pack or container), a per-package licence review is required first.
full_lock_license_note.source: counted from environments/vision/pixi.lock on 2026-10-17 (S08c); not an audit of package contents
